Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B
Upstream: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B
ONNX conversion: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B-ONNX
Conversion revision: 9995c50e2310679108a55f5ccd16ba8be9f17c20
License: Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
Reign derives a binary-score-only ONNX graph during explicit preparation.
The pinned Q4 weights are retained; floating tensors are converted to FP16 and
only the last position and no/yes output columns are materialized. Exact hashes
are pinned in embedding-model.lock.json and services/vector-worker/selection.py.
